title: Fix dependency resolution when branch name contains ']' character
summary: Fixed dependency resolution in GitHub Helper to correctly handle branch names containing the ] character by using literal path interpretation instead of wildcard matching.
key_points: Branch names can legally contain ] characters, which are treated as wildcards in PowerShell -Path parameter
GetDependencies was returning the folder itself instead of enumerating .app files when ] appeared in the folder name
Changed from -Path to -LiteralPath to treat the folder path literally without wildcard interpretation
No behavior change for existing branch names without brackets
Includes regression test to prevent future breakage
